finding.headline: "The Sandwich Mum (Toddler + School-Age + Newborn)"
finding.problem: "One needs homework, one needs a nappy, the baby needs milk — all at once, every day. I'm a triage nurse in my own kitchen."
finding.person: Mum of 6, 4 and a newborn; three different needs, zero overlap, meals a nightmare (Care.com, 2026).
